appDescription: A family road-trip stamp app that recommends nearby places within the time left before going home and tells their stories on arrival.

function.name: RECOMMEND_NEXT_PLACE
function.description: Recommend the next place to visit that fits the remaining time before the family's target return time.

preference.description: Optional preference for the kind of place to recommend.

function.name: PLAY_PLACE_STORY
function.description: Play the short audio story about the current or upcoming destination.

audience.description: Whether to play the full story or the short version for young children.

function.name: OPEN_STAMP_BOOK
function.description: Open the family's stamp book showing collected place stamps.
